tips.title: Helpful Financing Tips
tips.tip1Content1: Your monthly car payment is primarily determined by three factors:
tips.tip1L1: Loan Amount: The car price minus your down payment.
tips.tip1L2: Interest Rate: The percentage a bank charges for lending you money. Lower is better.
tips.tip1L3: Loan Term: How long you take to pay back the loan. Longer terms mean lower monthly payments but more total interest paid over time.
tips.tip2Content1: Since 1 June 2026, Malaysian hire-purchase loans charge interest only on the balance you still owe (the reducing balance), and banks must quote the EIR (effective interest rate). Compare EIR between banks. The rate you are offered depends on:
tips.tip2L4: The loan tenure (longer loans sometimes have higher rates)
tips.tip3Title: Benefits of a larger down payment
tips.tip3Content1: While the minimum down payment in Malaysia is usually 10%, putting down more upfront has several major benefits:
tips.tip3L1: Lower Monthly Installment: Reduces your monthly financial burden.
tips.tip3L2: Less Interest Paid: You borrow less, meaning you pay less total interest over the life of the loan.
tips.tip3L3: Better Approval Odds: Banks view you as a lower-risk borrower.
tips.tip3L4: Avoid Being 'Under Water': Protects you from owing more than the car is worth as it depreciates.
tips.tip4Content1: Malaysian car loans typically range from 5 to 9 years (60 to 108 months).
tips.tip4Content3: Higher monthly payments, but you pay off the car faster and save thousands in total interest.
tips.tip4Content5: Lower, more manageable monthly payments, but you will pay significantly more in total interest over the loan's lifetime.

waitlist.pain5: Dealer wants you to use their system. You want your own. There's no middle ground.
waitlist.gain5: Start free as a solo agent. One invite code and you merge under a dealer — keeping your track record.

lst.noReason: No reason was given. Check the details and photos, then resubmit.

lst.addPhotos_other: Add {{count}} more photos. Listings with 3+ photos get 3x more views

perf.noLeadsBody: Once buyers start coming in, this page shows where in your process deals are being lost, and what to change.
perf.closeCounts: {{won}} won · {{lost}} lost · {{total}} leads in total. Only won and lost deals count, so open leads do not drag it down.
perf.historyError: Could not load stage history, so this funnel would blame the wrong step. Reload the tab to try again.
perf.funnelNote: A lost deal counts at the stage it actually reached, not where it ended up.
perf.moreDetailSub: Reply speed, why deals are lost, lead sources
perf.noReplyTimes: No first-reply times recorded yet. Messaging a buyer from inside the app (the WhatsApp button on a lead, or a logged call) stamps when you first got back to them, and this card then shows what replying faster is worth.
perf.basedOn: Based on the {{pct}}% of your leads that have a first reply recorded.
perf.noLost: Nothing marked lost yet. Closing dead leads as lost, with a reason, is what fills this in.
perf.sourceNote: Close rate counts settled deals only, so a source with leads still open is not punished for them.
perf.noTrafficBody: List your stock and this page fills in on its own: views, tap-through and where buyers came from.
perf.emptyMini: No mini-page visits attributed yet. Share your profile link with the buttons in Listings to tag them.
perf.emptyCars: No attributed traffic yet. Share a listing with the share menu to start tracking.
perf.platformNote: A platform only shows up when the visit arrived through a tagged share link. Everything else counts as Direct.
perf.title: Performance
perf.subSelling: Based on every lead you have worked

weak_new.title: {{pct}}% of your leads were never contacted
weak_new.body: {{lost}} of your {{reached}} leads never moved past New, so nobody has worked them at all. That is the cheapest gap on this page to close: they are buyers who already put their hand up.

weak_stage.title: {{pct}}% of deals stop at {{stage}}
weak_stage.body: {{lost}} of the {{reached}} leads that reached {{stage}} never got past it. That is the single step costing you the most deals, so look at what you say and do there before changing anything else.

reply_speed.title: Replying within the hour closes {{fast}}% vs {{slow}}%
reply_speed.body: Leads you answered inside an hour closed at {{fast}}%. The ones that waited longer closed at {{slow}}%. Your typical first reply takes {{median}}.

speed_untracked.title: Reply speed is only tracked on some leads
speed_untracked.body: First-reply time is recorded on {{coverage}}% of your leads. Replying from inside the app (the WhatsApp button or a logged call) stamps it, and once most leads carry it this page can tell you what answering faster is actually worth.

frozen_pipeline.title: {{pct}}% of your open pipeline has gone quiet
frozen_pipeline.body: {{stuck}} of {{active}} open leads have had no movement in {{days}}+ days. Either they need a nudge or they need closing as lost. Leaving them open makes every rate on this page look better than it is.

loss_reason.title: {{reason}} is your most common reason for losing
loss_reason.body: {{count}} of the {{recorded}} losses you gave a reason for came down to {{reasonLower}}. That is the objection to have an answer ready for.

loss_untracked.title: Most lost deals have no reason recorded
loss_untracked.body: {{missing}} of {{total}} lost deals were closed without a reason. Picking one when you mark a deal lost is what turns this into a pattern you can fix.

source_gap.title: {{best}} leads close {{bestRate}}%, {{worst}} close {{worstRate}}%
source_gap.body: Not every lead is worth the same hour. {{best}} converted {{bestWon}} of {{bestSettled}} settled deals; {{worst}} converted {{worstWon}} of {{worstSettled}}.

close_up.title: Your close rate rose {{points}} points this month
close_up.body: {{current}}% of the deals you settled in the last 30 days were won, against {{previous}}% the 30 days before.

close_down.title: Your close rate fell {{points}} points this month
close_down.body: {{current}}% of the deals you settled in the last 30 days were won, against {{previous}}% the 30 days before.

on_track.title: Nothing is obviously leaking
on_track.body: {{won}} won and {{lost}} lost, a {{rate}}% close rate, and no single stage is shedding more than its share. Keep the pipeline moving.

need_data.title: Not enough closed deals to spot a pattern yet
need_data.body: This page gets sharper the more deals you close out. You have settled {{settled}} so far. Mark deals won or lost as they finish and the funnel, reply-speed and loss-reason numbers below start telling you where to focus.

fast.title: Fast list
fast.body: Photos, price and the basics, and the car is live in about 30 seconds. Fill in the rest later.

full.title: Full form
full.body: This is where you add a listing with every detail: new, used or recon, specs, condition and what's included. The more you fill in, the more a buyer trusts it.

more.title: More on each car
more.body: Tap ··· on a car for its loan poster, an AI caption or a broadcast.

add.title: Add a buyer
add.body: Walk-ins and phone calls go in here. Buyers from WhatsApp, chat and enquiries land here on their own.

stages.title: Stages
stages.body: Every buyer sits in one stage, from New to Won. Tap a stage to see who is in it.

more.title: Open a buyer
more.body: Tap ··· to move them to the next stage, add a note, log a call or set a reminder. Marking a buyer Won moves the car to Sold.

coming.title: Coming up
coming.body: What is due next across your buyers: handover steps, renewals and aftercare visits. Tap a row to open it.

handover.title: Handover
handover.body: Each sale gets a checklist: insurance, Puspakom, JPJ transfer, road tax and handover. Ticking insurance or road tax saves the expiry date, so renewal reminders come on time.

customers.title: Customers
customers.body: Everyone who bought from you. Add an aftercare plan and log their service visits here.

new.title: New application
new.body: Start from a lead or type the buyer in. Add the car and the deposit, and it works out the monthly and whether the buyer can carry it.

banks.title: Which banks
banks.body: Pick more than one bank. If the first says no, the next one is already on file.

list.title: Applications
list.body: Every application stays here. Update each bank's answer as it comes in.

segments.title: Who to message
segments.body: Your buyers, sorted by how warm they are. Pick a group, then tap a buyer to get a message ready to send.

campaign.title: Message a whole group
campaign.body: Goes through the group one chat at a time. WhatsApp opens with the message, and you press send each time.

menu.title: Make your first loan poster
menu.body: Your car is up. Now make the poster buyers share: tap ··· on your car.

open.title: Tap Loan poster
open.body: It opens with your price already filled in.

numbers.title: Check the numbers
numbers.body: Price, deposit and rate come from your listing. Change any of them and the poster updates as you type.

download.title: Download it
download.body: Tap Download poster. It saves to your phone, ready for WhatsApp status or TikTok.

firstSale.title: Congratulations, you sold your first car
firstSale.body: Your next commission starts in the Sold tab: finish the handover, then keep this buyer coming back for renewals, servicing and their next car.

availability.title: Viewing availability
availability.subtitle: Buyers can only book viewings on the days and times you set here. Set it once — days you're off are hidden from the booking calendar.
availability.pickDay: Pick at least one working day
availability.endAfterStart: End time must be after start time

pain.title: Every Dealer Hits The Same Walls
pain.subtitle: ShiftOS was built around the problems Malaysian dealers actually lose money to.
pain.label: The pain

p1.quote: What's the real profit on each unit? After recon, commission and transfer costs, I never really know.
p1.title: Real per-unit gross profit, automatically
p1.desc: ShiftOS computes front gross (sale - purchase - recon - services - commission - handover costs) AND back gross (F&I add-ons) for every unit. Open the P&L modal and see exactly what each car made - no spreadsheet, no guessing.

p2.quote: Once a deal closes, JPJ, Puspakom, loan settlement, road tax - it's all over the place. There's always a step we forget.
p2.title: The full Malaysian transfer checklist, seeded the moment a deal is won
p2.desc: Mark a lead won and a customer record is created + an 8-step handover checklist auto-seeded instantly: loan settlement, insurance, Puspakom B5/B7, JPJ pindah milik, road tax, geran, handover. Every step has the official fee, owner, and due date.

p3.quote: Salesmen report on themselves. It's hard to know who's actually productive and who's slow to reply to leads.
p3.title: Every lead, enquiry and test drive - auto-logged and attributed
p3.desc: No more trusting unverified WhatsApp screenshots. ShiftOS tracks response time, conversion rate, close rate, and gross per salesman, then ranks the whole team on a quality scorecard the owner can trust.

p4.quote: Submitting loans to banks one by one, with no view of which has the highest approval rate. Back-end revenue leaks away.
p4.title: Multi-bank HP submission with a live bank approval scorecard
p4.desc: Submit to multiple banks in parallel, track LOU and JPJ status per deal, and see each bank's real approval rate and days-to-decision. Capture F&I add-on revenue as back-end gross on every closed deal.

p5.quote: Posting one listing takes forever - uploading to the website, Telegram, and making TikTok content all separately.
p5.title: List once - published everywhere in under 5 minutes
p5.desc: Add a car and it auto-publishes to your branded xdrive.my storefront, auto-posts to your Telegram channel, and generates ready-to-post TikTok content slides. Zero copy-paste, zero designer required.

p6.quote: Customers buy once and that's it. Road tax & insurance expiry go untracked - repeat business and referrals vanish.
p6.title: Customer lifecycle that brings buyers back
p6.desc: Full customer record per sale with automatic road-tax and insurance renewal reminders at 30 and 7 days. Sell prepaid service packages, track visits, and turn one-time buyers into recurring revenue.
